notes.title: Join the Discord!
notes.content: [h1]Hey all![/h1][p]Yes, I am here begging you to join the damn Discord. It's great I swear, we got... like, text channels and stuff. I dunno. Just join and we'll figure stuff out from there.[/p][p]You get to talk to developers (me), you get to hear about announcements as they happen, you get to participate in events and early playtesting opportunities, all that stuff.[/p][p]Idk. Just join, it might be fun[/p][p](The image below is actually a link. Fancy right? Click that and you'll be on)[/p][p][url=https://discord.gg/r7yRuTJ6Us][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702007/0d66a1e7d53abb63f9954c3eaa295ad081e0e1d7.png"][/img][/url]
